options.text: showing courage when something is difficult

items.explanation: Brave means showing courage when something is difficult — like a firefighter who climbs a tree to save a cat.
Huge means very, very big, so a huge thing is bigger than a small one.

options.text: The elephant is huge, but it walks quietly.
I whisper to my friend in the library.
The new coin is shiny and clean.
The brave dog saved the kitten from the rain.

items.explanation: Whisper means to speak very softly, so it belongs in a quiet library.

items.prompt: Which word fits in this sentence: 'The ___ firefighter carried the cat down the tree.'
items.explanation: A firefighter who climbs a tree to save a cat shows courage, so brave fits best.

items.prompt: Find the word that means 'bright and reflects light'.
items.explanation: Shiny means bright and reflects light — that is why a new coin looks shiny.
